description: This file defines the XmlErrorRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering error exceptions as XML responses in the Slim Framework. It formats exception details into XML, optionally including detailed exception information when enabled.

classes.name: XmlErrorRenderer
classes.description: A renderer that converts PHP error exceptions into XML format for responses in the Slim Framework.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Generates an XML string representing the error, including detailed exception info if specified.

methods.name: createCdataSection
methods.description: Creates a CDATA section for XML content, safely handling the CDATA end marker within the content.
